scope: Frozen local B0 full-history reference replay with conditional assumed fills and explicit hypothetical cost/funding accounting.

decision.rationale: The B0 1.5R payoff geometry cannot meet the user-confirmed >$5 target under a <=$1 all-in loss cap. Historical performance remains conditional on unobserved fills, unmeasured execution costs, unknown account fees, unavailable platform minimum filters, and non-holdout data. Do not infer live profitability; complete native parity and collect venue-specific quotes/fills before deciding whether to continue or pivot the signal.

evaluation_policy.purpose: Predeclare the B0 historical scoring window, source inputs, warmup/reset behavior, risk and cost conventions, and model limitations before running the evaluation.

baseline.rule_definition: Execute the committed local B0 strategy rules as written, including rolling [2..4] EMA20 touch selection; do not substitute P1 first-touch rules or tune parameters.

source_hash_reconciliation.resolution: Current local strategy and indicator match the prior frozen manifest after its stated UTF-8 LF normalization. Their raw Windows CRLF hashes differ only due to line endings; no rule-source drift is indicated by these hashes.

baseline.platform_script_context: The connected TakeProfit working copy currently reports version 21 and P1 source, not the local B0 v16 source. Native comparison, if run, must use a temporary ephemeral copy of the frozen local B0 source; never run the current P1 copy as B0.

instrument.status: research proxy only; user execution venue remains unspecified

scoring_window.reason_not_holdout: These history windows and nearby chart periods have already been inspected in earlier project work. Results are exploratory and cannot be called out-of-sample validation.

history_and_warmup.coverage: Use complete independently resampled UTC buckets from #4. Reject timestamp gaps, duplicate bars, incomplete boundaries, and bars outside the frozen window.
history_and_warmup.native_reference_conflicts: Reset setup/HTF state at every execution or higher-timeframe source-conflict bucket listed in btc_history_coverage.json; exclude all events until at least 250 complete contiguous HTF bars and 56 execution bars have accumulated after reset.
history_and_warmup.initial_warmup: Require 250 complete HTF bars and 56 execution bars before scoring; use completed execution candles only; entry reference is the following execution bar open.
history_and_warmup.eligible_day_definition: UTC calendar day containing at least one scored execution decision after warmup/reset; retain zero-trade eligible days in daily R and equity summaries.
history_and_warmup.data_end: Do not force-close a position at the end boundary. Preserve it as open, report mark-to-market equity, and keep realized expectancy/PF on closed trades only.

risk_policy.leverage: 1x cash-constrained research sizing inherited from B0; not user account sizing
risk_policy.daily_loss_or_drawdown_locks: unset; do not invent personal limits
risk_policy.platform_min_order_filters: Unavailable for this research proxy; cannot assert platform-executable quantity or minimum notional. Report candidate quantities and flag this limitation.
risk_policy.user_profile_overlay: Separately disclose the user's confirmed $5-$10 margin, variable 20x-50x leverage, isolated mode, all-in loss cap <=$1, and target >$5. These personal limits are not substituted into the B0 10,000-USDT research sizing model.

fill_and_outcome_model.assumed_entry_fill: Full fill at B0 strategy's bounded quote: open*(1+0.0002) long or open*(1-0.0002) short; modeled only, not an observed fill. No queue, rejection, partial fill, or cancel/fill race is inferred.
fill_and_outcome_model.planned_stops_and_targets: Use the exact B0 stop distance, stop and 1.5R target derived from the bounded entry quote.
fill_and_outcome_model.protective_exit_source: Trade 1m OHLC. Stop gaps fill at the adverse minute open; same-minute stop/target collision is stop-first; otherwise fill at stop or target. No time exit.
fill_and_outcome_model.open_equity_source: Mark 1m close to value open positions; no mark-price protective execution is inferred.
fill_and_outcome_model.quantity_rounding: Floor size to 0.001 BTC as in the B0 input; min size/notional filters are unknown and therefore not verified.
fill_and_outcome_model.funding: Apply each actual funding_events.csv rate once when entry time is strictly before its event timestamp and the position is still open at the event; positive rate is paid by longs and received by shorts. Use mark 1m open at event minute as the funding notional proxy.

cost_scenarios.commission_status: Unverified TakeProfit backtest placeholder; user's account rates remain unknown.
cost_scenarios.base_composition: 10 bp modeled taker commission (5 bp per side) plus 5 bp unmeasured round-trip spread/slippage proxy. The 2 bp entry quote offset is already included in modeled fill price and is not deducted again.
cost_scenarios.stress_status: Only a hypothetical proxy stress is possible: measured spread/slippage is unavailable. It must not be described as measured or realistic for the user's venue.
cost_scenarios.fee_calculation: Charge 5 bp on entry notional and 5 bp on exit notional; apply the extra execution proxy half at each leg using each leg's notional. Funding is a separate signed cash flow.

uncertainty_and_decision_policy.uncertainty: Report event counts, 7-day circular block-bootstrap 95% interval for mean net R per eligible day when sample permits, plus assumption and history limitations.
uncertainty_and_decision_policy.sparse_sample: If fewer than 30 closed modeled fills, classify profitability inference as inconclusive; no win-rate or PF claim for open-only/no-trade samples.
uncertainty_and_decision_policy.concentration: Report share of positive net PnL contributed by the top five UTC winning days and net PnL excluding them.

native_reference_reconciliation.conclusion: The local independent engine completed the full 24-month reference replay. TakeProfit's 5,060-bar cap prevents the required native 24-month runs, and the bounded snapshots did not honor the requested scoring end. Native/reference parity and native order/fill reconciliation remain unverified; do not use the zero-trade bounded snapshots as evidence of zero B0 activity or flat profitability.

user_economics_overlay.arithmetic_conclusion: A fixed 1.5R target cannot gross $5 when all-in planned loss is capped at $1 (at most $1.50 gross before costs); the B0 target/risk geometry does not meet the stated personal dollar target. At the declared 10-20 bp modeled cost, the user-sized net outcome is lower. This is an objective mismatch, not a performance estimate.

known_limits: No historical best bid/ask or user's account fee rate was provided; 5 bp per side plus an unmeasured impact proxy are assumptions.
Every submitted model order assumes immediate full fill at the bounded quote. Queue position, partial fills, order rejections, and cancel/fill races are unknown.
Exchange tick size, minimum quantity, and minimum notional filters are not verified; model sizes below the known 0.001 BTC step are rejected, but platform eligibility remains unknown.
Funding is event-specific but mark-price notional uses the open of the event minute as a proxy, not an exchange settlement snapshot.
The evaluation window was previously inspected and is not an untouched holdout.
The local strategy and indicator hashes match the frozen manifest after UTF-8 LF normalization; raw Windows CRLF hashes are recorded separately in the evaluation policy.
User's personal risk limits are not used to size this 10,000 USDT research baseline. Account-level daily loss and drawdown limits remain unset.
